completion_criteria.text: hooks/lib/pre-tool-use.mjs inverted to deny-by-default inside a protected root: any resolvable token under a protected root DENIES unless the segment head is on an explicit read-only allowlist. shell-tokens.mjs left unchanged.

Both directions proven by committed tests: all 12 verified evasions (including `( rm -rf <root> )` and `sudo rm -rf <root>`) assert DENY, and the 41-command read-only corpus asserts ALLOW. Red-before/green-after evidence recorded.
The scanSegments blow-up resolved so the guard fails CLOSED on oversized or pathological input, never open, with a test asserting the fail-closed path at the boundary.
Full plugin test suite green on the branch, and a fresh code-reviewer plus security-reviewer pass over the final diff returns no CRITICAL or HIGH findings.

Branch merged to main, plugin published to the marketplace, and re-installed globally - then a live end-to-end check against the real store shows a real evasion DENIED and ordinary read commands still ALLOWED.

spine.active_goal: Invert the PreToolUse Bash guard from allow-unless-provably-destructive to deny-by-default inside a protected root, so parse gaps in the hand-rolled bash tokenizer stop being silent evasions. Then prove both directions, review, merge, publish, re-install. Successor to ledger-v2-archive-and-seed.
spine.next_step: RE-DISPATCH solution-architect for the deny-by-default design (decisions A-H). The prior run was stopped before writing anything - the target file .claude/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-26-pre-tool-use-guard-deny-by-default-design.md DOES NOT EXIST. Then get a USER CALL on the over-block bill, on allow/deny/ask as a third verdict, and on whether the three silent allow-paths are in scope. Only then TDD.
open_risks: NEEDS A USER SCOPING CALL before anyone acts: the three silent allow-paths are each a bigger hole than the parse gaps, but sit OUTSIDE this thread's five immutable criteria. Do not widen scope unilaterally.

pre-tool-use.mjs:115-116 returns {} - a total bypass of every check for every tool - when roots resolve empty. hook-io.mjs:50-57 swallows exceptions and exits 0. readHookInput returns {} on malformed stdin. runEntry is shared by ALL hooks, so a global fail-closed fix risks breaking session startup.
G0 IS DONE - do not re-measure. 159-case OLD-vs-TIP matrix at scratchpad/guardbench/ is SESSION-SCOPED and probably gone. Rebuild from 0016 rather than trusting any inherited count.

Neither guard dominates (0016). OLD ~19 read-only false positives + 10 evasions; TIP 0 false positives but ~21-23 evasions. The inherited 20-command figure conflated evasions with correct over-block relaxations.
MERGE BLOCK STANDS on fix/pre-tool-use-guard, for the corrected reason in 0016: the tip trades evasion coverage for false positives. It is NOT uniformly worse than the live guard.
Tip 5f04dd4 is one commit past the b0e1079 that decisions 0008 and 0011 evaluated, and shell-tokens.mjs did NOT exist at b0e1079. Treat both decisions as formed against a different guard.
10 holes predate BOTH versions and are new allowlist scope: sh/bash/zsh -c '<string>'; find <ROOT> -delete and -exec; git -C <ROOT> clean -fdx and reset --hard; xargs rm -rf < list.txt.

ALLOWLIST TRAPS: find must not be blanket-allowlisted (-delete/-exec); git needs -C/--git-dir/--work-tree operand awareness, not just a subcommand list; sh -c puts a whole command in ONE token that never path-resolves under a root; do NOT allowlist echo.

PIPELINE BLINDNESS is unclosable with the tokenizer frozen: scanSegments discards WHICH separator was used, so `echo <ROOT> | xargs rm -rf` cannot be seen as a pipeline. Mitigate by keeping the read-only allowlist minimal.

QUADRATIC IS NOT A LIVE HAZARD (measured): slowest classification 0.29 ms, steady state 0.02-0.11 ms, zero hangs across 159 cases. Criterion 3's cap bounds deliberate abuse only; size it so no realistic command trips it.
Suite is 513 pass / 0 fail WHILE 21+ evasions exist. Green proves nothing here - it covers prefix-word and grouping evasion not at all.
$'...' ANSI-C quoting defeated both regex and tokenizer on the sibling guard; our shell-tokens.mjs has NO handling and is frozen. Treat $' as suspicious. See 0015.
The 12-evasion and 41-command corpora DO NOT EXIST as artifacts - coverage floors only, and the existing 51 assertions need verdicts REWRITTEN not extended. See 0014.
CRITERIA TENSION: criterion 1 freezes shell-tokens.mjs but the quadratic lives there (:64, :72). Satisfy criterion 3 by capping input in pre-tool-use.mjs BEFORE it calls scanSegments.

CORRECTION, do not re-add as if missing: the tip ALREADY checks redirect targets head-independently (:66-68) and ALREADY tracks cd across && segments (:72-74). The gap is solely the 14-verb DESTRUCTIVE head set at :76.
Concurrent sessions write ONE store. 0012 was taken by another session while this one wrote 0013-0016. Decision numbers are not contiguous.
